about_short_description.short_description: RuDo is a wealth-building platform that provides wealth through microsaving, automated investing, and financial education.

product.name: RuDo Smart
product.description: A digital investment advisory service that manages globally diversified portfolios for NRI professionals through automated investing, rebalancing, and goal-based allocation.

product.name: RuDo Grow
product.description: A hybrid investment advisory service combining automated portfolio management with personal advisor access, financial planning, and periodic portfolio reviews for NRI investors.

product.name: RuDo Elite
product.description: A private wealth management service for established investors, offering customized portfolios, senior advisor access, and performance-based fees above a high-water mark.

product.name: Cross-Border Wealth Advisory
product.description: An integrated wealth advisory service for Indian professionals in the UAE, coordinating investments, currencies, financial goals, and account structures across India and global markets.
